name: Statistical IV characterization (threshold voltage, subthreshold swing, hysteresis) of commercial 1.2 kV 4H-SiC power MOSFETs from 300 K to 650 mK
plain_name: Check whether a commercial silicon-carbide power transistor still switches reliably below 1 K
description: Bare-die Wolfspeed CPM3-1200-0013A SiC MOSFETs are bonded to a sample holder on the mixing-chamber plate of a dilution refrigerator; the plate is set between 0.65 K and 25 K (plus a 300 K reference) and output/transfer curves are acquired at least 50 times per temperature with two SMUs in Kelvin (four-wire) mode.
keywords: Check whether a commercial silicon-carbide power transistor still switches reliably below 1 K

sources.citation: Reproducibility and variability in commercial SiC MOSFETs at deep-cryogenic temperatures (Powell et al., arXiv:2507.23109, 2025)

requirements.rationale: The lowest measurement temperature was 650 mK.
Devices were characterized across the span from 650 mK to 300 K.
Drain and gate are driven and sensed by two SMUs in four-wire mode.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
